settings.classification: Inspected-data diagnostic reuse; not fresh confirmation.

limitations: All ten seeds inspected and reused diagnostically; no fitting or fresh profit evidence.
Exact fractional-share reference knows dealt hidden cards, splits ties fractionally (no engine odd-chip allocation), and assumes no future betting: not actionable regret or GTO.
Restricted paid flop/turn call/fold diagnostic excludes preflop, raises and river search.
All actions also reported separately for observer-active states; sampled value states are first paid eligible per hand, lowest fixed hashes.
